summary: Measure what THIS pod's ffmpeg/GPU build can do to a synthetic HLG clip (release/probe/hdr-hlg-v1.mp4): ffmpeg version, the pod ffmpeg build/asset it runs, hwaccels, filters, GPU facts from nvidia-smi, a probe of the fixture and, per candidate decode/encode path, whether it works. Measurement only — it chooses no decode path; which candidate the pool uses is the brain's.

parity.note: `caps` is the bit_exact target: on one pod build, the same fixture yields the same capability facts. Timings (per-candidate wall_s / realtime_factor / peak_vram_delta_mb) are MEASUREMENTS that vary run to run, and they ride the separate `caps_timings` output for exactly that reason — so the parity claim on `caps` never has to carry a clock.
